description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1413/21 of 06.10.2005 in respect of the Aquinas Collage of Higher Studies for substitute the scheduel
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends a previous order regarding degree programs and abbreviations at Aquinas College of Higher Studies. It establishes regulatory requirements and compliance conditions for the institution, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) that cover statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and legal amendments. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, so it doesn't qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
